ledger_ref.description: skip the closed OS matcher when firmware_en=0

snapshot.path: parent tree is the m-051 tree, not a new archived snapshot. chain_base is the m-030 file hash, not the tree parent.

semantics.summary: firmware_en=0 still reports hwinfo finished, so m-030 does not stop init_os_name. The closed matcher then reads the OS release file. Debian's vendor initramfs hook loads fantgpu before root is mounted, and that read crashes. This patch returns DMA_POINTER_NORMAL before the matcher when firmware_en is 0. It does not move the existing hwinfo check. When firmware_en=0 and the OS would match NFSDesktop or SeewoOs, the mode is NORMAL instead of DMAIRQ or HWTIMER. The project default is 0 and the targets are Debian and Gentoo, so that difference is accepted and recorded. The closed object body, including the bad-pointer path, was not reviewed line by line. The basis is the live crash chain and three Debian kernels booting after the same guard.

license.evidence: Same pending-audit rule as m-036 and m-051. The license gate already accepts this m- patch. The edit stays in the existing vendor Dual MIT/GPLv2 audio file; no new dependency, binary or third-party code. pending-audit is not an unreviewed patch.

dependencies.summary: Parent file already contains m-030. m-052 is not inserted into derive_fantgpu_source. Debian applies it to the packaged DKMS tree after derive. Gentoo applies it after m-051.

o_stage_adaptation.summary: No Deepin behavior change. m-030 bytes are unchanged.

adjacent_code.summary: Only fantsrvkm/fantaudio_drv.c. firmware_en remains declared in fantgpu_pci_drv.c.

apply.result: One file. Strict replay on the i6 audio file passes and reverse restores f08d9a31. No .orig or .rej. Whole-tree hash is recorded after the clean builds.
